_comment: Polo symbol: a cursive P drawn in one pencil line (stem, bowl, a loop at the foot). 100x100 grid, centred. Two passes of the same line give the pencil feel: a main stroke and a thinner, offset, lighter one. Read by src/components/primitives.tsx (LogoMark) and scripts/make-icons.mjs so the app icon and the in-app mark are one drawing.
